body:
# **Villager Trader**

**Villager Trader** adds a brand-new functional **block**
that lets you **automatically trade with villagers.**

## **How it works**
- Place the **Villager Trader block.**
- Make a **Villager stand on top of it.**
- **Rename the Villager** to the trade number you want (e.g., “1”, “2”, “3”…).
- Put a **chest (or any container)** _above the villager_ and fill it with the items required for that trade.
- The Villager Trader will automatically take items from the container and perform the trade.

## **Current Limitations (ALPHA)**
- Only supports trades with **one buy item.**
- Functionality is **very buggy** and **may not work** reliably.
- Some trades **may not trigger** or **may break** under certain conditions.
- **Multi-item trades** are not yet supported.
- You may **lose your items** when putting them into Villager Trader.

## **Useful Commands**
Give yourself Villager Trader 
```
/loot give @s loot tinys_vt:items/villager_trader
```
